rationale: The supported optimization is P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout), which is in scope for workflow_yaml and has a reviewed pattern with estimated benefit plus a measured_ci_workflow_on_fork experiment example showing a timeout bound reduced elapsed time. Prerequisites are met: the repository CI history shows representative successful runs (about 14 seconds, all success), so a 10-minute timeout gives ample operational headroom and will not interrupt valid slow runs, avoiding the contraindication. The change is minimal and preserves all intended build/test coverage: the same three lint jobs (hadolint, yamllint, shellcheck) still run on the same triggers with the same steps and permissions. It only replaces the default unbounded runner timeout with an explicit 10-minute bound per job, which bounds runaway consumption without adding secrets, network access, publishing/deployment, or weakened permissions.
